label: World population
note: Peaks mid-2040s, earlier than UN mid-estimates, because fertility falls faster than expected nearly everywhere.

label: Life expectancy, rich countries
note: Flat for a decade, then climbs once aging therapies clear approval.

label: Cognitive work done by AI
note: Share of measurable knowledge-work output produced by or with AI systems.

label: Average paid hours per week
note: Rich-country average. The jobs question resolves through shorter weeks and transfers, not mass idleness.

label: Warming above pre-industrial
note: 1.5°C missed in the late 2020s; 2°C breached around 2050; peak and slow decline after as emissions fall and removal scales.

label: Humans living off-Earth
note: Nearly all in orbit or on the Moon through 2100.

label: Actors at the AI frontier
note: Organizations or states able to train and deploy systems within a year of the best. The hinge, as a number.
